use_case_name: Exchange IFF and SIF Transponder Data

claims.content: To exchange IFF/SIF modes and codes to ensure commonality of IFF/SIF data between the IUs.

goal.raw_text: To exchange IFF/SIF modes and codes to ensure commonality of IFF/SIF data between the IUs.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU is a JU with R² if it is to transmit J3.XC1.
The C2 JU has R² for the track if it is responsible for IFF/SIF surveillance data reporting in the J3.2C1 and J3.3C1 words for Air and Surface tracks.
If the C2 JU is a nonR² unit responding to a J7.5 (ACT = 2) message from the R² unit, valid local data (nonzero codes) are held for the requested mode(s).
The applicable mode indicators are set when requesting update of IFF/SIF data via J7.5 (ACT = 2).
The C2 JU manually initiates a J7.5 (ACT = 2) IFF/SIF Update Request with the applicable mode indicators set when requesting update of IFF/SIF data.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU manually initiates a J7.5 (ACT = 2) IFF/SIF Update Request with the applicable mode indicators set when requesting update of IFF/SIF data.

claims.content: The C2 JU manually initiates the J7.5 (ACT = 2) IFF/SIF Update Request with the applicable mode indicators set when requesting update of IFF/SIF data.
R² units receiving the J7.5 (ACT = 2) message respond by initiating a J3.XC1 message regardless of the No Data status.
NonR² units receiving the J7.5 (ACT = 2) message from the R² unit respond by initiating a J7.5 (ACT = 1) message if valid local data (nonzero codes) are held for the requested mode(s).
When an operator receives an IFF/SIF data conflict alert as required in Table 4.7-5, the operator may update local data manually or verify automatic inputs.
When an operator receives an IFF/SIF data conflict alert as required in Table 4.7-5, the operator may initiate a J7.5 (ACT = 0) Clear IFF/SIF message (any mode).
When an operator receives an IFF/SIF data conflict alert as required in Table 4.7-5, the operator may initiate a J7.5 (ACT = 1) IFF/SIF Difference Report message (any mode).
When an operator receives an IFF/SIF data conflict alert as required in Table 4.7-5, the operator may change local data to agree with remote data except in the case of Mode II code.

When an operator receives an IFF/SIF data conflict alert as required in Table 4.7-5, the operator may decorrelate the local data from the remote data, causing the assignment of a new track number to local data.
When an operator receives an IFF/SIF data conflict alert as required in Table 4.7-5, the operator may clear operator alert (any mode).
For new tracks when assuming R² or when data changes, the JU with R² transmits J3.XC1 at the next opportunity.

Any JU without R² entering a change of nonzero to nonzero or zero to nonzero value to its locally held Mode I, III or IV IFF/SIF data, or a change from zero to nonzero Mode II data, shall automatically report the new data in a J7.5 (ACT = 1) message.
JUs without R² are responsible for monitoring IFF/SIF data and only reporting if they hold different data with the J7.5 message.

Exception path 1 — No Data status: R² units receiving the J7.5 (ACT = 2) message respond by initiating a J3.XC1 message regardless of the No Data status; exit the exception path after initiating the J3.XC1 response.

Exception path 2 — Mode II code: change local data to agree with remote data except in the case of Mode II code; in the case of Mode II code, exit the exception path without changing local data to agree with remote data.
The R² unit has initiated a J3.XC1 message in response to the J7.5 (ACT = 2) message, regardless of the No Data status.
A nonR² unit receiving the J7.5 (ACT = 2) message from the R² unit has initiated a J7.5 (ACT = 1) message if valid local data (nonzero codes) are held for the requested mode(s).
